tests/unit/test_llm_capabilities.py (diff): `anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5` changed from `supports_temperature is True` to `is False`
src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py:566: `"supports_temperature": caps.supports_temperature` is written into the signed provenance record, so the meaning of this recorded field also flips for these models

Absence: the diff adds no config key, env var or CLI flag to opt a model into sampling; the docs (docs/llm-framework.md) and the failure.py message point only at the private `rebar.llm.capabilities._SAMPLING_ACCEPTING_MODEL_IDS`
advisory.finding: `REBAR_LLM_TEMPERATURE` / `[llm] temperature` now changes behaviour for every provider, with no way back. Before this change, a configured value was sent to any model not on a short deny-list. Now it is sent only to ids in the private `_SAMPLING_ACCEPTING_MODEL_IDS`, which lists only Bedrock models and direct Claude 4.5/4.6. Direct OpenAI (`openai:gpt-4o`), Google, Groq and direct `claude-sonnet-4-5` now silently drop an explicit operator temperature, and the verifier's temperature-0 pin no longer reaches them either. The only signal is a once-per-model INFO log. There is no config key, env var or flag to opt a model back in: the docs and the error message both say to edit a private module constant.
scenarios: An operator running `openai:gpt-4o` or a Gemini model with `REBAR_LLM_TEMPERATURE=0` for reproducible gate runs now gets the provider's default sampling, and nothing fails.
Completion-verifier runs on direct non-Claude-4.5/4.6 providers lose the temperature-0 pin (completion.py), so verdicts become less deterministic.
Readers of signed verdict provenance see `supports_temperature: false` for models that previously recorded `true`, with no version marker.
